financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Private placement of secured notes ($1.15M principal, OID), closed Aug 2, 2024; proceeds before expenses

warrants.quote: On July 15, 2022, the Company issued 231,828 common stock purchase warrants with an exercise price of $2.01 as part of the conversion of promissory notes.
The IPO warrants are exercisable into one common share of the Company at $4 per share and expire on November 21, 2028.
